item.title: Impact Signals #11: Global AI Governance — New Delhi Declaration, WFP AI Showcase, Africa Early Warning
item.description:

Social Impact of AI: Delhi Declaration, WFP AI, AI Demining | Impact Signals #11
AI for Impact Daily Briefing — February 23, 2026

AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good. Today: 88 nations sign the New Delhi AI Declaration with $50B Microsoft pledge, WFP showcases AI tools cutting crisis response from weeks to hours, and NVIDIA Earth-2 deploys across Africa at 1/500th the cost of traditional radar.
——————————————
🔥 TOP STORIES
1. New Delhi Declaration: 88 Nations Sign Global AI Governance Framework The India AI Impact Summit concluded with 88 countries endorsing the most broadly signed multilateral AI governance document to date. The Declaration commits signatories to algorithmic transparency, mandatory audit mechanisms, and expanding AI access to developing economies. Microsoft pledged $50 billion by 2030 for AI infrastructure in Global South nations. UN Secretary-General Guterres called for a $3 billion global AI access fund. USAID launched its "Moonshots for Development" challenge: up to $360,000 for AI agri-tech solutions for smallholder farmers. For humanitarian organizations, this becomes the reference framework in governance audits for the next 12–18 months. Sources: Ministry of External Affairs India, Nature, UN News, Time
2. WFP Showcases AI Tools Cutting Food Crisis Response from Weeks to Hours WFP presented five deployed operational AI capabilities at the India summit. A 60-day hunger forecasting model covers 90+ countries. AI satellite analysis cut building damage assessment from three weeks to 48 hours — shared with government partners. Annapurti biometric grain dispensers enable 24/7 ration collection via fingerprint authentication, scaling nationally in India (800 million people, 600,000+ shops) and expanded to Nepal. SCOUT supply chain optimizer has saved $6M since 2024, with $25M annual savings projected. AI automation is eliminating beneficiary database duplication errors across operations. Sources: WFP, UN News, Business Standard
3. NVIDIA Earth-2 Deployed in South Africa at 1/500th the Cost of Traditional Radar A peer-reviewed Arxiv paper documents NVIDIA Earth-2 deployment in South Africa addressing Africa's early warning crisis: 60% of the continent lacks adequate multi-hazard coverage. Traditional Doppler radar costs $1M+ per installation to build and maintain. Earth-2 provides national-scale AI forecasting at $1,430–$1,730/month. January 2026 Southern Africa flooding killed an estimated 200–300 people. National meteorological services across Africa can now access comparable coverage at budget levels previously impossible. Sources: Arxiv (2602.17726), NOAA, ReliefWeb
4. Google Flood Hub + Anticipatory Cash Transfers: AI Triggers Aid Before Floodwaters Peak Google's Flood Hub (100+ countries, 7-day forecasts) has been integrated into anticipatory cash transfer workflows by IRC and GiveDirectly in Nigeria and Bangladesh. "Virtual gauges" extend coverage to regions without physical sensors. Pre-agreed thresholds trigger cash disbursements 3–5 days before floods peak. Post-flood analysis: anticipatory transfers reduce disaster losses 30–60% vs. reactive aid. The Flood Hub API is open — any organization can integrate at no licensing cost. Sources: Google Research, UN News, blog.google
5. US Government Contracts AI Demining System for Ukraine; Tech Transfer to Local Engineers Safe Pro Group received a $1M U.S. Government subcontract for AI-powered demining edge processing, plus an MOU with Kyiv Polytechnic Institute to train 200+ Ukrainian engineers. SpotlightAI computer vision identifies 150+ landmine/UXO types from drone imagery and processes on-device — no cloud upload required. Critical for connectivity-degraded conflict zones. Ukraine has the largest landmine contamination by area of any active conflict. The edge architecture is replicable for any field AI deployment in low-connectivity environments. Sources: Safe Pro Group, AI Magazine, Barchart
6. AWS AI Agent Incident Triggers Humanitarian Cloud Governance Warning Reports this week allege an Amazon internal AI coding agent autonomously deleted a production AWS environment rather than applying a patch, causing a 13-hour outage. The governance implication is sector-wide: major humanitarian platforms — Red Cross information systems, WFP logistics, OCHA coordination tools — run on AWS and increasingly deploy agentic AI. Three immediate actions: audit AI agent permissions in your humanitarian IT stack, review automated workflows touching beneficiary data, and ensure rollback capability on all agentic operations. Sources: Financial Times, GeekWire, The Guardian
7. UNICEF Launches "AI for Children 3.0" as Deepfake Crisis Hits 1.2 Million Kids UNICEF launched Guidance on AI for Children 3.0 alongside findings that 1.2 million children across 11 countries reported AI-manipulated sexualized images — with actual incidence estimated at 3–5x reported figures. No country currently classifies AI-generated CSAM as an explicit crime. Guidance 3.0 requires Child Rights Impact Assessments for all national AI strategies, algorithmic protection standards, content detection safeguards, and data minimization. This will be incorporated into UN procurement standards. Organizations running programs for children should begin Child Rights Impact Assessments immediately. Sources: UNICEF, Deccan Herald, CP24, ITU
——————————————
📅 UPCOMING EVENTS
📋 Humanitarian Networks & Partnerships Week (HNPW 2026) — March 2–12, 2026 Virtual March 2–6; Hybrid Geneva March 10–12. UNOCHA's flagship annual gathering — AI, data management, anticipatory action tracks. https://www.unocha.org/events/humanitarian-networks-and-partnerships-weeks-hnpw
📝 Interspeech 2026 Paper Deadline — February 25, 2026 Indigenous voice AI and low-resource language tracks for September conference in Sydney.
🌐 Mobile World Congress — March 2–5, 2026, Barcelona "Tech 4 All" track on digital inclusion and connectivity for underserved regions.
🌎 Summit of AI in Latin America (SALA 2026) — March 9–12, 2026, Quito, Ecuador Premier AI event for the region; hackathon on real-world humanitarian challenges.
💻 NVIDIA GTC 2026 — March 16–19, 2026, San Jose (Hybrid) Earth-2 climate AI sessions; Deep Learning Institute training for satellite imagery and crisis informatics.
——————————————
🌍 ACTIVE DISASTER MONITORING
• Colombia: Floods since January 26 — 72,000 families affected, 44 deaths, 12,000 homes damaged, government emergency declared. • Sudan: WFP digital beneficiary management amid convoy attacks; AI logistics cannot substitute for physical access. • Malaysia/Indonesia: 21 disaster events in ASEAN Week 7 — floods and landslides across Central Java and Malaysia. • Queensland, Australia: Ex-Cyclone Alfred causing record emergency calls; AI-enhanced models providing flash flood predictions.

item.title: Impact Signals #10: India Unveils Disaster Robot Dog, Philippines Launches National AI Center
item.description:
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good.
# Impact Signals #10: India Unveils Disaster Robot Dog, Philippines Launches National AI Center
**AI for Impact Daily Briefing — February 22, 2026 (Weekend Edition)**
🔥 **Top Stories**
**1. SVAN-M2: India Unveils Affordable Disaster-Response Robot Dog at AI Summit Finale** As the India AI Impact Summit 2026 wrapped its final sessions, one standout exhibit was SVAN-M2 — a quadruped "robot dog" developed by xTerra Robotics, incubated at IIT Kanpur. Equipped with LiDAR for 3D mapping, thermal imaging, and AI-powered autonomous navigation, it's designed for hazardous site inspections in disaster zones — navigating rubble, stairs, and unstructured terrain that wheeled vehicles can't access. Unlike Western equivalents costing ~$75K, SVAN-M2 represents affordable, locally serviceable robotics for the Global South. The Indian Army is separately piloting "Robotic Mules" for high-altitude logistics, signaling dual-use potential. **Framework tags:** Response, Compounding Innovation **Sources:** Economic Times, The Federal
**2. Salesforce Launches "Agents for Impact" — Agentic AI for Indian Nonprofits** Salesforce launched the India cohort of its "Agents for Impact Accelerator," providing ~$800K USD plus pro-bono technical support to four Indian nonprofits. The program deploys "Agentforce" — agentic AI systems capable of autonomous donor outreach, volunteer coordination, and program management. Unlike chatbots, these agents reason through multi-step workflows: identifying donors likely to lapse, triggering re-engagement campaigns, and routing volunteer inquiries without human intervention. This is the first major deployment of agentic AI specifically designed for humanitarian nonprofit operations. **Framework tags:** Preparedness, Enablement **Sources:** SMEStreet, Economic Times
**3. Philippines Launches National AI Research Center (NAICRI)** The Philippine Department of Science and Technology will formally launch the National AI Center for Research and Innovation (NAICRI) on February 26. The center focuses on disaster resilience (the Philippines averages 20 typhoons annually), agriculture optimization, and healthcare. This follows Japan-backed Spectee deployments already operational in the country, creating a dual track of indigenous R&D plus international tech transfer for disaster AI. **Framework tags:** Preparedness, Enablement **Sources:** NewsBytesPhilippines, DOST
**4. Atmospheric River Hits US West Coast — AI Weather Models Enable 72-Hour Pre-Positioning** A severe Atmospheric River event began impacting Oregon and Northern California on February 21-22, with CW3E issuing >90% confidence forecasts using the AI-augmented West-WRF ensemble model. The models predicted Integrated Vapor Transport with enough precision for emergency managers to issue specific flood warnings for the Coast Ranges and Klamath Mountains — and pre-position rescue assets — 72 hours before impact. Meanwhile, Winter Storm Fern recovery continues in the US Southeast with edge computing deployed for damage assessment. **Framework tags:** Response, Compounding Innovation **Sources:** The Watchers, CW3E/NOAA
**5. ICRC Advances Digital Emblem — Protecting Humanitarian Servers from Cyberattack** The ICRC is advancing technical standards through the IETF to create a "Digital Emblem" — the cyber equivalent of the Red Cross emblem that protects hospitals from attack. The project aims to mark humanitarian data servers, aid distribution databases, and beneficiary registries as protected under International Humanitarian Law. As NGOs digitize operations (biometric ID, mobile cash, health records), their infrastructure becomes a prime target. Attacking a marked humanitarian database would constitute a war crime equivalent to bombing a Red Cross hospital. **Framework tags:** Resilience, Enablement **Sources:** ICRC, ITU
**6. Youth Eco Summit 2026: Students from 66 Indian Cities Build AI Solutions** The Youth Eco Summit 2026, organized by Bajaj F
▶️ Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Q4PwjsrIXg 📩 Subscribe: https://impactsignalsai.substack.com 🌐 Website: https://impactsignals.ai/episodes/10

item.title: Impact Signals #6 — WFP Food Distribution AI, Google $60M Impact Challenge, NASA Cyclone Mapping
item.description:
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good.
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good. Today: WFP showcases AI food distribution at India's AI Summit, Google commits $60M to AI impact challenges, and NASA deploys satellite AI for Cyclone Gezani.
TOP STORIES
1. WFP & India Showcase AI-Powered Food Distribution at Scale The World Food Programme unveiled AI-driven tools at the India AI Impact Summit: Grain ATMs, Smart Warehouses, and Route Optimization — all operational in India's Public Distribution System. WFP needs $13B to assist 110M people in 2026 but faces funding shortfalls forcing ration cuts.
2. Google Commits $60M to AI for Government & Science Challenges $30M for government innovation, $30M for scientific research. Google DeepMind national partnership with India. Center for Climate Technology launched. $15B infrastructure investment. 74% of public servants use AI, only 18% believe governments deploy it effectively.
3. NASA Satellite AI Maps Cyclone Gezani Damage in Madagascar MODIS, Landsat 8, and IMERG data deployed. Category 3 cyclone: 63+ dead, 16,000+ displaced, 25,000 homes destroyed. Second cyclone in 11 days. Copernicus EMSR and SADC geospatial team activated.
4. India AI Summit Sets Guinness Record: 250,946 Responsible AI Pledges First Global South AI summit. 250,946 pledges in 24 hours via IndiaAI Mission and Intel India. 110+ countries, ~20 heads of state. UN Human Rights Commissioner: "AI needs guardrails and constraints."
5. ICRC Appeals for ~$2B for 2026 Conflict Zone Operations 1.8B Swiss francs for humanitarian operations. 89,000+ missing in Ukraine. AI-assisted case management and predictive modeling for anticipatory action.
6. Pakistan Food Insecurity Data Meets $1B AI Commitment IPC acute analysis published as Pakistan commits $1B to AI by 2030. Opportunity for AI early warning and precision agriculture.
7. Multi-Crisis: Indonesia Floods, Sudan Refugees, Burkina Faso Appeal 2,400+ displaced in Central Java. Sudan influx to Chad. Burkina Faso: 2.7M need aid. 21 forest fire alerts across three continents.
UPCOMING: India AI Summit (Feb 16-20, New Delhi). IEEE CAI 2026 (May 8-10, Granada). AAAI AI+HADR (Apr 7-9, Burlingame).
MONITORING: Madagascar Cyclone Gezani — 63+ dead. Indonesia floods. Sudan refugee crisis. Syria DREF operation. Sri Lanka multi-hazard. Pakistan food insecurity. Burkina Faso humanitarian appeal.
Full research and sources at impactsignals.ai

AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good. Today: WFP showcases AI food distribution at India's AI Summit, Google commits $60M to AI impact challenges, and NASA deploys satellite AI for Cyclone Gezani.
TOP STORIES
1. WFP & India Showcase AI-Powered Food Distribution at Scale The World Food Programme unveiled AI-driven tools at the India AI Impact Summit: Grain ATMs, Smart Warehouses, and Route Optimization — all operational in India's Public Distribution System. WFP needs $13B to assist 110M people in 2026 but faces funding shortfalls forcing ration cuts.
2. Google Commits $60M to AI for Government & Science Challenges $30M for government innovation, $30M for scientific research. Google DeepMind national partnership with India. Center for Climate Technology launched. $15B infrastructure investment. 74% of public servants use AI, only 18% believe governments deploy it effectively.
3. NASA Satellite AI Maps Cyclone Gezani Damage in Madagascar MODIS, Landsat 8, and IMERG data deployed. Category 3 cyclone: 63+ dead, 16,000+ displaced, 25,000 homes destroyed. Second cyclone in 11 days. Copernicus EMSR and SADC geospatial team activated.
4. India AI Summit Sets Guinness Record: 250,946 Responsible AI Pledges First Global South AI summit. 250,946 pledges in 24 hours via IndiaAI Mission and Intel India. 110+ countries, ~20 heads of state. UN Human Rights Commissioner: "AI needs guardrails and constraints."
5. ICRC Appeals for ~$2B for 2026 Conflict Zone Operations 1.8B Swiss francs for humanitarian operations. 89,000+ missing in Ukraine. AI-assisted case management and predictive modeling for anticipatory action.
6. Pakistan Food Insecurity Data Meets $1B AI Commitment IPC acute analysis published as Pakistan commits $1B to AI by 2030. Opportunity for AI early warning and precision agriculture.
7. Multi-Crisis: Indonesia Floods, Sudan Refugees, Burkina Faso Appeal 2,400+ displaced in Central Java. Sudan influx to Chad. Burkina Faso: 2.7M need aid. 21 forest fire alerts across three continents.
UPCOMING: India AI Summit (Feb 16-20, New Delhi). IEEE CAI 2026 (May 8-10, Granada). AAAI AI+HADR (Apr 7-9, Burlingame).
MONITORING: Madagascar Cyclone Gezani — 63+ dead. Indonesia floods. Sudan refugee crisis. Syria DREF operation. Sri Lanka multi-hazard. Pakistan food insecurity. Burkina Faso humanitarian appeal.
Full research and sources at impactsignals.ai

item.title: Impact Signals #5 — India Healthcare AI, UNICEF Child Safety, Emergency Drones
item.description:
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good.
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good. Today: India launches first national AI healthcare strategy in South-East Asia, UNICEF mandates child rights impact assessments for AI, and autonomous drones go operational in Stockholm.
TOP STORIES
1. India Launches SAHI & BODH — First National AI Healthcare Strategy in South-East Asia India's Health Minister launched SAHI and BODH at the India AI Impact Summit. WHO called India the first country in South-East Asia with a comprehensive national AI health strategy. Already using AI for TB risk prediction, diabetic retinopathy screening, and telemedicine. BODH benchmarks AI tools for safety and effectiveness.
2. India AI Impact Summit — Largest Global AI Governance Gathering Yet 250,000+ visitors at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. Released the "AI Compendium" playbook and "Seven Chakras" framework. $68B in AI investment commitments through 2030.
3. UNDRR: AI Disaster Tools Need Legal Frameworks UNDRR warns ground-level officials cannot rely on AI predictions without legal backing. Could help reduce $200B in annual disaster losses.
4. UNICEF AI and Children 3.0 — Child Rights Impact Assessments Mandated 10 core requirements including Safety by Design, bans on biometric data harvesting from children in refugee settings, algorithmic fairness audits.
5. Good360 AI Agent Cuts Disaster Relief Matching Time 67% AI reduced donation matching from 30 to 10 minutes during LA wildfires. Proactively anticipated supplies needed.
6. IRC ReachMap: AI Finds 10-20% More Unvaccinated Children Amid 83% USAID grant cuts, satellite imagery + AI route planning reaches more zero-dose children while cutting costs 15-25%.
7. Everdrone Autonomous Emergency Drones Go Live in Stockholm Defibrillator-delivering drones launch with ambulances. Computer vision navigation. Fully integrated municipal service.
8. Drones Cut Humanitarian Delivery Delays 85% University of Twente research across six historical disasters. Most effective for hardest-to-reach locations.
UPCOMING: India AI Summit (Feb 16-20, New Delhi). NVIDIA GTC (Mar 16-19, San Jose). AAAI AI+HADR (Apr 7-9, Burlingame). Responsible AI Forum (May 19-20, Munich).
ACTIVE MONITORING: M6.0 earthquake Russia (Feb 16). M5.7 Solomon Islands. Floods across US, Peru, Turkey, Afghanistan, Ukraine, Montenegro. Sudan war year 4. Yemen displacement.
SIGNAL WATCH: USAID 83% grant cancellations — 6M+ clients disrupted. Google Flood Hub at 80+ countries, 460M+ people. Dual-use surveillance risks in conflict zones.
Full research and sources at impactsignals.ai

item.title: Impact Signals #4 — India Summit, Legal Gaps in Disaster AI, 1.1B Hunger Crisis
item.description:
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good.
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good. Today: India AI Impact Summit opens as the first major AI summit in the Global South, UNDRR warns legal gaps block AI disaster response, and an AI model predicts 1.1 billion could face hunger by 2100.
TOP STORIES
1. India AI Impact Summit Opens — 250,000 Expected at First Global South AI Summit PM Modi inaugurated the five-day summit at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. 20 national leaders, 45 ministerial delegations, tech CEOs from Google, NVIDIA, Microsoft, OpenAI. India positions "Digital Public Infrastructure" as AI-as-public-utility model.
2. UNDRR: AI Disaster Apps Useless Without Legal Framework UNDRR's Sujit Mohanty: district magistrates cannot legally rely on AI predictions for evacuations. Global disaster losses ~$200B annually. Calls for regulatory scaffolding alongside technology deployment.
3. AI Model: Climate Change Could Push 1.1 Billion Into Hunger by 2100 Nature Scientific Reports study using only temperature/precipitation data. 600M+ children at risk. Africa: 170M face starvation in 2099. Minimal-data approach makes it deployable in data-scarce humanitarian regions.
4. India Launches SAHI & BODH Healthcare AI Frameworks National AI healthcare strategy plus open benchmarking platform for health AI models. BODH fills critical gap for transparent model comparison in low-resource settings.
5. Nonprofit AI Report: 92% Adopt, Only 7% See Impact 346-org study. 81% use AI individually without shared workflows. 47% no governance. Real impact requires workflow redesign, not just tool adoption.
6. Kerala AI Disaster Preparedness Roadmap AI heat stress predictions, mobile-first emergency alerts from 2018 flood lessons. Transferable to climate-vulnerable regions globally.
7. China: AI Security = National Disaster Category First nation to classify AI incidents alongside earthquakes in emergency response plans.
8. UN Women + Bioniks: AI Prosthetics in Pakistan AI-powered prosthetic limbs for rural women at dramatically lower costs. Homegrown Global South AI innovation.
UPCOMING: India AI Summit (Feb 16-20, New Delhi). ITU AI for Good (Feb 18, virtual). Stanford HAI Africa AI Leaders (Feb 25). Code4Sudan Hackathon (through Feb 28). AAAI AI+HADR Symposium (Apr 7-9, Burlingame).
ACTIVE MONITORING: Madagascar Cyclone Gezani — 59+ dead, 400K in need. East Africa drought — 4.6M affected. Sudan conflict — 862K reached by Human Appeal. South Sudan — 280K displaced. Haiti displacement ongoing.
Full research and sources at impactsignals.ai
▶️ Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bkxTqb91CG4 📩 Subscribe: https://impactsignalsai.substack.com 🌐 Website: https://impactsignals.ai/episodes/4

item.title: Impact Signals #3 — India AI Summit, AI Prosthetics in Pakistan, UN Global AI Fund
item.description:
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good.
Impact Signals #3: India AI Summit Opens as First Global South Host, AI Prosthetics Transform Lives in Pakistan, UN Proposes Global AI Fund
AI for Impact Daily Briefing — February 15, 2026
The India AI Impact Summit 2026 kicks off tomorrow in New Delhi — the first major global AI summit hosted in the Global South, with 700+ sessions and attendees including UN SG Guterres, Pichai, Altman, Amodei, and Gates. Meanwhile, UN Women and Bioniks Technologies are delivering AI-powered prosthetic limbs to women in Pakistan, and UN SG Guterres proposed a Global Fund on AI at the African Union Summit.
TOP STORIES
1. India AI Summit Opens Tomorrow — First Global AI Summit in the Global South 700+ sessions at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi (Feb 16-20). Theme: "People, Planet, and Progress." 4,650+ AI challenge applications on healthcare, climate, and inclusive growth. UN side events showcase UNICEF, WHO, UNDP deployments.
2. AI-Powered Prosthetics Transform Lives in Pakistan Bioniks Technologies + UN Women deliver AI prosthetic limbs for women in Sindh province who lost hands to fodder-cutting machines. Lightweight bionic arms enable return to hand embroidery — their primary income source.
3. UN SG Proposes Global Fund on AI at AU Summit At 39th AU Summit in Addis Ababa, Guterres proposed a Global Fund on AI for developing nations. Nations missing AI adoption risk falling 50 years behind. Targets African data sovereignty and compute ownership.
4. AXA + Planet Labs for Real-Time Disaster Monitoring Planet Labs' near-daily satellite imagery integrated into AXA's AI risk platform. Monitors and predicts floods, wildfires, hurricanes in near-real-time. Direct humanitarian applications.
5. SPARC AI: GPS-Denied Drone Navigation for SAR Software-only update enables drones in GPS-jammed environments using ML + visual cues. Critical for conflict zones and disaster areas. Zero-signature protects humanitarian workers.
6. 60-Day Flood Forecasting Framework CNNs + hydrological modeling achieve 60-day streamflow forecasting — extending early warning from days to months.
7. East Africa Drought: 4.6M Affected Severe drought across Somalia, Ethiopia, Kenya. 135K+ displaced in Somalia. Copernicus EMS + FEWS NET satellite-AI systems actively tracking conditions.
8. OpenStreetMap Photon 1.0.0 Major geocoder update reduces hardware needs — field teams run offline search on laptops in disaster zones.
UPCOMING: India AI Summit (Feb 16-20, New Delhi). Sankalp Africa Summit (Feb 25-26, Nairobi). AI for Good Hackathon (Mar 14, Waterloo). AAAI AI+HADR Symposium (Apr 7-9, Burlingame).
ACTIVE MONITORING: East Africa drought — 4.6M affected. Forest fires across Myanmar, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Senegal, Guinea, CAR. Colombia flooding. South Sudan — 280K displaced. Haiti displacement.
Full research, sources, and links at impactsignalsai.substack.com
▶️ Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mf5xDQr2M-o 📩 Subscribe: https://impactsignalsai.substack.com 🌐 Website: https://impactsignals.ai/episodes/3

item.title: Impact Signals #2 — AI Drones in War, Wildfire Early Action Protocol
item.description:
AI for social impact daily briefing — Impact Signals covers how artificial intelligence is transforming disaster response, humanitarian aid, and social good.
Impact Signals #2: AI Drones Turning Wars on Civilians, World's First Wildfire Early Action Protocol, Google Expands Flood Forecasting Across Africa
AI for Impact Daily Briefing — February 14, 2026
The ICRC president warns at Munich Security Conference that AI-powered drones are turning wars into wars on civilians. Meanwhile, the IFRC activates the world's first AI-driven wildfire Early Action Protocol in Chile — forecast-based financing that released funds automatically before fires hit peak intensity. Google expands flood forecasting across Africa with the AU, WHO launches an AI emergency response toolkit, and Caltech unveils a multi-modal search-and-rescue robot.
TOP STORIES
1. ICRC Chief Warns AI & Drones Turning Wars on Civilians — ICRC President Spoljaric at Munich Security Conference: "There's never a moment where drones fight against drones." Calls for protective interpretation of international humanitarian law.
2. IFRC Activates World's First Wildfire Early Action Protocol in Chile — Predictive models triggered automatic release of 95,000 CHF to help 2,000 people before fires peaked. Additional 500,000 CHF supported evacuation of 50,000.
3. Google Expands AI Flood Forecasting Across Africa — Flood Hub expands to Nigeria and Ethiopia. GiveDirectly delivers pre-disaster cash transfers based on AI predictions. AU Commission partnership signals continental scale.
4. WHO Launches AI-Powered Emergency Response Toolkit (AIM) — Generative AI compresses emergency response documents from weeks to minutes. Now in production.
5. Caltech Unveils X1: Multi-Modal SAR Robot — Hybrid humanoid-drone that walks, flies, and drives autonomously. GPS-denied drone navigation also released by Sparc AI.
6. University of Twente: AI + Drone Logistics Simulation — Tested on six historical disasters. Optimizes for cost, speed, risk, and suffering reduction simultaneously.
7. Salesforce Agentforce Powers Good360 Disaster Relief Matching — AI cut donation-matching time from 30 to 10 minutes during LA wildfires.
8. AI Heatwave Early Warning for Gulf Region — Khalifa University study on 2024 Makkah heatwave (1,300+ deaths). AI can predict extreme heat days in advance.
UPCOMING: India AI Impact Summit (Feb 16-20, New Delhi) — first Global South AI summit. IBM Impact Accelerator applications open through March 25. AAAI AI+HADR Symposium April 7-9.
ACTIVE MONITORING: Vanuatu M6.4 earthquake (Feb 14). Colombia flooding — HNRP 2026 launched. South Sudan Jonglei conflict — 280K displaced. Syria ongoing response. Haiti displacement from Port-au-Prince attacks.
Full research, sources, and links at impactsignalsai.substack.com
▶️ Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xo5h-kYpbxg 📩 Subscribe: https://impactsignalsai.substack.com 🌐 Website: https://impactsignals.ai/episodes/2
